item.title: US security agreement for Ukraine is ‘100% ready’ to be signed, Zelenskyy says
item.description: (AP) — President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Sunday that a U.S. security guarantees document for Ukraine is “100% ready” after two days of talks involving representatives from Ukraine, the U.S. and Russia. Speaking to journalists in Vilnius during a visit to Lithuania, Zelenskyy said Ukraine is waiting for its partners to set a signing date, after which the document would go...

item.title: A man is under arrest for assaulting U.S. Rep. Maxwell Frost at the Sundance Film Festival
item.description: A man was arrested Friday night at a party during the Sundance Film Festival in Park City, Utah, for allegedly assaulting a Florida congressman.

item.title: More than 10,800 flights canceled Sunday as massive winter storm sweeps across US
item.description: A massive winter storm made for a brutal travel day Sunday, with widespread cancellations and delays at some of the nation's busiest airports.

item.title: Republican calls are growing for a deeper investigation into the fatal Minneapolis shooting
item.description: A growing number of Republicans are pressing for a deeper investigation into federal immigration tactics in Minnesota after a U.S. Border Patrol agent fatally shot a man in Minneapolis, a sign that the accounting of events by President Donald Trump's administration may face bipartisan scrutiny.

item.title: Iran unveils mural warning of retaliation if US conducts a military strike
item.description: Iranian authorities unveiled a new mural on a giant billboard in a central Tehran square on Sunday with a direct warning to the United States to not attempt a military strike on the country, as U.S. warships head to the region.

item.title: As temperature begins to drop, Warming Shelter ILM gets ready to open for a week
item.description: Warming Shelter ILM is set to open for a whole week, to help those without homes.

item.description: The New Hanover County branch of the NAACP hosts MLK Breakfast to honor Dr. Marin Luther King Jr.

item.title: Castle Hayne resident hopes to get justice after losing her leg
item.description: Local Castle Hayne resident hopes to get good news ahead of her meeting with the District Attorney, after losing her leg nearly three years ago in a vehicle accident.

item.description: According to the Highway Patrol, just before 2 am, a car was rear-ended between the Union Valley exit and the Peacock Road overpass.

item.title: Pender Post lawsuit drops claims against 3 county commissioners
item.description: Last year, the paper ran a series of editorials and cartoons depicting Commissioners Randy Burton, Brent Springer, and Jerry Graves as puppets of the county's Republican Party leadership.
